map.简支梁与连续梁的弯矩公式为何不同？: Why do the moment formulas differ between simply supported and continuous girders?
map.连续梁因中间支座产生负弯矩，内支点弯矩最大（(g+q)L²/12）、跨中较小（(: A continuous girder develops negative moments at the intermediate supports, so the interior support moment is largest ((g+q)L²/12) and the midspan smaller ((g+q)L²/24); a simply supported beam is largest only at midspan ((g+q)L²/8). The bridge type choice directly affects the reinforcement quantity and cost.
map.桥墩数为何是跨数减一？: Why is the number of piers the span count minus one?
map.n 跨连续布置有 n-1 个中间桥墩加 2 个桥台；本工具桥墩数取 n-1，桥台: n spans laid out continuously have n-1 intermediate piers plus 2 abutments; this tool takes the pier count as n-1 and counts abutments separately, since piers and abutments both transfer loads but differ in construction.
